references.title: Our History
observations: Riverside acquired an existing church building in April 2006.
The congregation identifies its current location as 1850 Woodland Avenue near Salisbury and Lindberg in West Lafayette.
references.geometry_use: Building identity and address corroboration only; no exterior dimensions, elevation, floor count, or roof description are provided.

references.title: Covenant Curch — West Lafayette, IN (2022)
observations: KJG describes a renovation of the church's sanctuary and entry spaces.
The project text mentions full-glass doors at an interior entry, a renovated lobby and lounge, and cantilevered entry canopies at childcare check-in.
references.geometry_use: Confirms a 2022 interior renovation scope. It does not identify the building's exterior roof shape, measured height, facade layout, or the location and dimensions of exterior doors and canopies.
